title: The h7 Sentry
setup: Your queen and bishop are lined up at h7, and besides the king, only the knight on f6 covers that square.
hint: Your battery already points at h7. Exactly one black piece answers it — what is that piece worth?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bxf6}} removes the only guard of h7. Recapture with {{gxf6}} and {{Qxh7#}} is mate: Black's own rook on f8 walls the king in. Decline, and the knight is gone for nothing. An even trade that opens a mating square is never even.
